speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe the exact location of your pain and tell me if it has radiated to your back or shoulder. Also, have you experienced any nausea, vomiting, or fever since the onset?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mesenteric Ischemia (Acute)

The combination of sudden abdominal pain, bloody stools, and your recent myocardial infarction strongly suggests intestinal ischemia due to low blood flow. Given the critical nature of this condition, I need to see the results of your lactate levels and a CT angiogram of your abdomen immediately.
